decisions.choice: the LORD's answer to Jeremiah's prayer, from verse 27 to verse 44
decisions.reason: The narrator speaks of Jeremiah by name again, as in verses 1-6. The answer has two parts: the city will fall because of its long rebellion (verses 28-35), and yet the LORD will gather his people, make an everlasting covenant with them, and bring back life to the land (verses 36-44).

decisions.choice: the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah, saying (L); came to Jeremiah (B); the LORD gave Jeremiah this message (R)
decisions.reason: The wording set for this formula throughout Jeremiah. The LORD's speech opens a quotation in verse 27 that closes at the end of verse 44.

source.text: הִנֵּה֙ אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֔ה אֱלֹהֵ֖י כָּל־בָּשָׂ֑ר הֲֽמִמֶּ֔נִּי יִפָּלֵ֖א כָּל־דָּבָֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: Look, I [am] Yahweh, [the] God of all flesh; for me is too hard any thing?

en.L: "Look, I [am] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of all flesh; is anything too hard for {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}?
en.B: "Look, I am {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of all humanity. Is there anything too hard for {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}?
en.R: "I am {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of all people. Is anything too hard for {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}?

es.L: «He aquí, yo [soy] {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, el Dios de toda carne; ¿hay algo demasiado difícil para {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}?
es.B: «Mira, yo soy {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, el Dios de toda la humanidad. ¿Hay algo demasiado difícil para {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}?
es.R: «Yo soy {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, el Dios de toda la gente. ¿Hay algo demasiado difícil para {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}?

fr.L: « Voici, je [suis] {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, le Dieu de toute chair ; y a-t-il quelque chose de trop difficile pour {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} ?
fr.B: « Je suis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, le Dieu de toute l’humanité. Y a-t-il quelque chose de trop difficile pour {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} ?
fr.R: « Je suis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, le Dieu de tous les êtres humains. Est-ce que quelque chose est trop difficile pour {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} ?

sw.L: "Tazama, {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} [ni] {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa wote wenye mwili; je, kuna neno lililo gumu {{deity_pronoun:kwangu|Kwangu}}?
sw.B: "Tazama, {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} ni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa wanadamu wote. Je, kuna jambo lolote lililo gumu {{deity_pronoun:kwangu|Kwangu}}?
sw.R: "Mimi ni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa watu wote. Je, kuna jambo lolote lililo gumu {{deity_pronoun:kwangu|Kwangu}}?

vi.L: "Kìa, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} [là] {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của mọi xác thịt; có việc gì quá khó cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} chăng?
vi.B: "Kìa, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của cả loài người. Có việc gì quá khó cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} chăng?
vi.R: "Ta là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của mọi người. Có việc gì quá khó cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} không?

decisions.choice: is anything too hard for me?: the LORD takes up Jeremiah's words of verse 17 and the question of Genesis 18:14
decisions.reason: Jeremiah had confessed that nothing is too hard for the LORD, and then shown his puzzlement (verses 24-25). The LORD answers with the very question he once asked Abraham (Genesis 18:14). The answer the question expects is plain: nothing is. What follows shows how: the city must fall, and yet the land will be bought again (verses 42-44).

decisions.choice: the God of all flesh: God of every human being
decisions.reason: "Flesh" means living creatures, especially human beings in their weakness (Numbers 16:22; Isaiah 40:5-6). The LORD rules over all peoples, Babylon included.

decisions.choice: all flesh (L); all humanity (B); all people (R); too hard (all levels)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what "flesh" means here. "Too hard" matches verse 17 at every level.

decisions.choice: lililo gumu kwangu
decisions.reason: God answers Jeremiah with his own words from verse 17 ("lililo gumu kwako"), so every level repeats them.

decisions.choice: "quá khó" (too hard), as in verse 17
decisions.reason: God answers Jeremiah with his own words of verse 17, so "quá khó" is kept the same at every level.

source.text: לָכֵ֕ן כֹּ֖ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה הִנְנִ֣י נֹתֵן֩ אֶת־הָעִ֨יר הַזֹּ֜את בְּיַ֣ד הַכַּשְׂדִּ֗ים וּבְיַ֛ד נְבֽוּכַדְרֶאצַּ֥ר מֶֽלֶךְ־בָּבֶ֖ל וּלְכָדָֽהּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Therefore thus says Yahweh: Look I [am] giving the city this into [the] hand of the Chaldeans and into [the] hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, and he will capture it.

en.L: Therefore thus says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}: Look, I am giving this city into the hand of the Chaldeans and into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, and he will capture it.
en.B: Therefore {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says this: I am about to hand this city over to the Chaldeans and to Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, and he will capture it.
en.R: So this is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says: I am going to hand this city over to the Babylonians and to their king Nebuchadrezzar, and he will capture it.

es.L: Por tanto, así dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: He aquí, yo entrego esta ciudad en mano de los caldeos y en mano de Nabucodorosor, rey de Babilonia, y él la tomará.
es.B: Por eso {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dice esto: Voy a entregar esta ciudad a los caldeos y a Nabucodorosor, rey de Babilonia, y él la tomará.
es.R: Por eso, esto es lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: Voy a entregar esta ciudad a los babilonios y a su rey Nabucodorosor, y él la tomará.

fr.L: C’est pourquoi ainsi parle {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : Voici, je livre cette ville entre les mains des Chaldéens et entre les mains de Nabuchodonosor, roi de Babylone, et il la prendra.
fr.B: C’est pourquoi {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit ceci : Je vais livrer cette ville aux Chaldéens et à Nabuchodonosor, roi de Babylone, et il la prendra.
fr.R: Alors voici ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : Je vais livrer cette ville aux Babyloniens et à leur roi Nabuchodonosor, et il la prendra.

sw.L: Kwa hiyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asema hivi: Tazama, ninautia mji huu mkononi mwa Wakaldayo, na mkononi mwa Nebukadreza mfalme wa Babeli, naye atautwaa.
sw.B: Kwa hiyo hivi ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asemavyo: Ninakaribia kuutia mji huu mikononi mwa Wakaldayo na mikononi mwa Nebukadreza mfalme wa Babeli, naye atauteka.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo hili ndilo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} analosema: Nitautia mji huu mikononi mwa Wababeli na mfalme wao Nebukadreza, naye atauteka.

vi.L: Vì vậy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán thế này: Kìa, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ phó thành này vào tay người Canh-đê và vào tay Nê-bu-cát-rết-sa vua Ba-by-lôn, và vua ấy sẽ chiếm lấy nó.
vi.B: Vì vậy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán như vầy: Ta sắp phó thành này vào tay người Canh-đê và Nê-bu-cát-rết-sa vua Ba-by-lôn, và vua ấy sẽ chiếm lấy nó.
vi.R: Vì vậy, đây là lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán: Ta sắp giao thành này cho quân Ba-by-lôn và vua của chúng là Nê-bu-cát-rết-sa, và vua ấy sẽ chiếm lấy nó.

decisions.choice: I am giving this city into the hand of ...: the words Zedekiah held against Jeremiah
decisions.reason: The LORD repeats the message of verse 3 that Zedekiah had quoted in anger. It stands: the city will fall.

decisions.choice: Nebuchadrezzar: the form with r, as the Hebrew has it here
decisions.reason: As in verse 1; each verse keeps the form its Hebrew uses.

decisions.choice: Therefore thus says the LORD (L); Therefore the LORD says this (B); So this is what the LORD says (R); Babylonians (R)
decisions.reason: The formula keeps the wording set for Jeremiah, and Readable says "Babylonians" for "Chaldeans" and "their king" to link the two.

source.text: וּבָ֣אוּ הַכַּשְׂדִּ֗ים הַנִּלְחָמִים֙ עַל־הָעִ֣יר הַזֹּ֔את וְהִצִּ֜יתוּ אֶת־הָעִ֥יר הַזֹּ֛את בָּאֵ֖שׁ וּשְׂרָפ֑וּהָ וְאֵ֣ת הַבָּתִּ֡ים אֲשֶׁר֩ קִטְּר֨וּ עַל־גַּגּֽוֹתֵיהֶ֜ם לַבַּ֗עַל וְהִסִּ֤כוּ נְסָכִים֙ לֵאלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים לְמַ֖עַן הַכְעִסֵֽנִי׃

records.literal_gloss: And will come the Chaldeans, the [ones] fighting against the city this, and they will set on fire the city this with fire and burn it, and the houses which they burned incense on their roofs to the Baal and poured out drink offerings to gods other, so as to provoke me.

en.L: And the Chaldeans who are fighting against this city will come and set this city on fire and burn it, with the houses on whose roofs they burned incense to Baal and poured out drink offerings to other gods, to provoke {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}.
en.B: The Chaldeans who are fighting against this city will enter it and set it ablaze. They will burn it, and the houses too, where people burned incense to Baal on the roofs and poured drink offerings to other gods, provoking {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} to anger.
en.R: The Babylonians who are attacking this city will come in and set it on fire. They will burn it down, along with the houses where people burned incense to Baal on the roofs and poured out drink offerings to other gods. They did this to make {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} angry.

es.L: Y vendrán los caldeos que pelean contra esta ciudad, y prenderán fuego a esta ciudad y la quemarán, con las casas sobre cuyas azoteas quemaron incienso a Baal y derramaron libaciones a otros dioses, para provocarme.
es.B: Los caldeos que pelean contra esta ciudad entrarán y le prenderán fuego. La quemarán, y también las casas en cuyas azoteas la gente quemaba incienso a Baal y derramaba libaciones a otros dioses, provocándome a ira.
es.R: Los babilonios que atacan esta ciudad entrarán y le prenderán fuego. La quemarán por completo, junto con las casas donde la gente quemaba incienso a Baal en las azoteas y derramaba ofrendas de vino a otros dioses. Hacían eso para hacerme enojar.

fr.L: Et les Chaldéens qui combattent contre cette ville viendront et mettront le feu à cette ville et la brûleront, avec les maisons sur les toits desquelles on a brûlé de l’encens à Baal et répandu des libations à d’autres dieux, pour {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}irriter.
fr.B: Les Chaldéens qui combattent contre cette ville y entreront et y mettront le feu. Ils la brûleront, ainsi que les maisons où les gens brûlaient de l’encens à Baal sur les toits et versaient des libations à d’autres dieux, pour {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}irriter.
fr.R: Les Babyloniens qui attaquent cette ville vont y entrer et y mettre le feu. Ils la brûleront, avec les maisons où les gens brûlaient de l’encens pour Baal sur les toits et versaient des offrandes de vin pour d’autres dieux. Ils faisaient cela pour {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} mettre en colère.

sw.L: Na Wakaldayo wanaopigana na mji huu watakuja na kuutia mji huu moto na kuuteketeza, pamoja na nyumba ambazo juu ya dari zake walimfukizia Baali uvumba na kuimiminia miungu mingine sadaka za kinywaji, ili kunikasirisha.
sw.B: Wakaldayo wanaoushambulia mji huu wataingia na kuuwasha moto. Watauteketeza, pamoja na nyumba ambazo juu ya dari zake watu walimfukizia Baali uvumba na kuimiminia miungu mingine sadaka za kinywaji, wakinikasirisha.
sw.R: Wababeli wanaoushambulia mji huu wataingia na kuuwasha moto. Watauchoma kabisa, pamoja na nyumba ambazo juu ya dari zake watu walimfukizia Baali uvumba na kuimiminia miungu mingine sadaka za kinywaji. Walifanya hivyo ili kunikasirisha.

vi.L: Người Canh-đê đang tấn công thành này sẽ đến và phóng lửa đốt thành này, đốt cả những nhà mà trên mái người ta đã đốt hương cho Ba-anh và đổ rượu dâng cho các thần khác, để chọc giận Ta.
vi.B: Người Canh-đê đang tấn công thành này sẽ vào và phóng hỏa thành. Chúng sẽ đốt thành, đốt luôn những nhà mà trên mái người ta đã đốt hương cho Ba-anh và đổ rượu dâng cho các thần khác, để chọc giận Ta.
vi.R: Quân Ba-by-lôn đang tấn công thành này sẽ vào và phóng hỏa thành. Chúng sẽ đốt rụi thành, cùng với những nhà mà trên mái người ta đã đốt hương cho thần Ba-anh và đổ rượu dâng cho các thần khác. Người ta đã làm vậy để chọc giận Ta.

decisions.choice: on whose roofs they burned incense to Baal: worship on the flat rooftops
decisions.reason: Houses had flat roofs, open to the sky, where people set up altars and offered to other gods (19:13; Zephaniah 1:5; 2 Kings 23:12). The fire that destroys the city will consume the very places where the sin was done.

decisions.choice: burned incense: made offerings go up in smoke
decisions.reason: The verb means to make something smoke as an offering. It is used of burning incense and also of burning parts of other offerings; here and in 19:13 incense is the most likely sense.

decisions.choice: to provoke me: the purpose, or the result, of their worship
decisions.reason: The phrase can say what the worshipers aimed at or what their worship did. Either way, worship of other gods stirred up the LORD's anger (7:18; 11:17; 25:6-7).

decisions.choice: people (B, R); to provoke me (L); to provoke me to anger (B); to make me angry (R)
decisions.reason: "They" who worshiped on the roofs are the city's people, not the Chaldeans; Balanced and Readable say "people" to keep the two apart. Balanced and Readable complete the idea of provoking, which in Hebrew means stirring to anger.

source.text: כִּֽי־הָי֨וּ בְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל וּבְנֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֗ה אַ֣ךְ עֹשִׂ֥ים הָרַ֛ע בְּעֵינַ֖י מִנְּעֻרֹֽתֵיהֶ֑ם כִּ֣י בְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אַ֣ךְ מַכְעִסִ֥ים אֹתִ֛י בְּמַעֲשֵׂ֥ה יְדֵיהֶ֖ם נְאֻם־יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: For have been [the] sons of Israel and [the] sons of Judah only doing the evil in my eyes from their youth; for [the] sons of Israel only [are] provoking me by [the] work of their hands, declaration of Yahweh.

en.L: For the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel and the {{gender:children|sons}} of Judah have been doing only what is evil in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} eyes from their youth; for the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel have only been provoking {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} with the work of their hands, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: From their youth the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} and the {{gender:people|sons}} of Judah have done nothing but evil in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} sight. The {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} have done nothing but provoke {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} with what their hands have made, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: Ever since they were young, the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} and the {{gender:people|sons}} of Judah have done only what I say is evil. The {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} have done nothing but make {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} angry with the idols they have made, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: Porque los hijos de Israel y los hijos de Judá no han hecho sino lo malo ante {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} ojos desde su juventud; porque los hijos de Israel no han hecho más que provocarme con la obra de sus manos, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.B: Desde su juventud, los israelitas y la gente de Judá no han hecho más que lo malo ante {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} ojos. Los israelitas no han hecho más que provocarme con lo que han hecho sus manos, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.R: Desde que eran jóvenes, los israelitas y la gente de Judá solo han hecho lo que yo considero malo. Los israelitas no han hecho más que hacerme enojar con los ídolos que han fabricado, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Car les {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël et les {{gender:enfants|fils}} de Juda n’ont fait que ce qui est mal à {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} yeux depuis leur jeunesse ; car les {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël n’ont fait que {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}irriter par l’œuvre de leurs mains, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Depuis leur jeunesse, les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} et les {{gender:gens|fils}} de Juda n’ont fait que le mal à {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} yeux. Les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} n’ont fait que {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}irriter par ce que leurs mains ont fabriqué, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Depuis le début de leur histoire, les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} et les {{gender:gens|fils}} de Juda n’ont fait que ce que je considère comme mal. Les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} n’ont fait que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} mettre en colère avec les idoles qu’ils ont fabriquées, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Kwa maana wana wa Israeli na wana wa Yuda wamekuwa wakitenda yaliyo maovu tu machoni {{deity_pronoun:pangu|Pangu}} tangu ujana wao; kwa maana wana wa Israeli wamekuwa wakinikasirisha tu kwa kazi ya mikono yao, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Tangu ujana wao Waisraeli na watu wa Yuda hawajafanya kitu kingine ila maovu machoni {{deity_pronoun:pangu|Pangu}}. Waisraeli hawajafanya kitu kingine ila kunikasirisha kwa vitu walivyotengeneza kwa mikono yao, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Tangu walipokuwa vijana, Waisraeli na watu wa Yuda wamefanya tu yale ninayoyaona kuwa maovu. Waisraeli hawajafanya kitu kingine ila kunikasirisha kwa sanamu walizotengeneza, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

vi.L: Vì con cái Y-sơ-ra-ên và con cái Giu-đa từ thuở nhỏ chỉ làm điều ác trước mắt Ta; vì con cái Y-sơ-ra-ên chỉ chọc giận {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} bằng công việc tay chúng làm, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy.
vi.B: Từ thuở ban đầu, dân Y-sơ-ra-ên và dân Giu-đa chẳng làm gì khác ngoài điều ác trước mắt Ta. Dân Y-sơ-ra-ên chẳng làm gì khác ngoài việc chọc giận {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} bằng những thứ tay chúng làm ra, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy.
vi.R: Từ thuở ban đầu, dân Y-sơ-ra-ên và dân Giu-đa chỉ làm những điều {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} coi là ác. Dân Y-sơ-ra-ên chẳng làm gì khác ngoài việc chọc giận {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} bằng những thần tượng do chúng làm ra, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán.

decisions.choice: the work of their hands: the idols they made, and perhaps all their deeds
decisions.reason: The phrase often means idols, made by human hands (1:16; 25:6-7; Deuteronomy 31:29). It can also mean all that people do. Here, with "provoking me", idols are most likely in view.

decisions.choice: from their youth: from the start of their history as a people
decisions.reason: The nation's youth is its beginning in Egypt and the wilderness (2:2; 3:24-25; 22:21).

decisions.choice: only: they have done nothing else
decisions.reason: The little word stands twice, sharpening the charge: their whole history has been evil and provocation. It is a prophet's sweeping judgment, not a denial that there were faithful people.

decisions.choice: the sons of Israel and the sons of Judah: the whole people, north and south
decisions.reason: Israel here may be the northern kingdom, taken into exile long before (3:6-11), alongside Judah. In the second half of the verse Israel names the whole people.

decisions.choice: children of Israel (L); Israelites (B, R); people of Judah (B, R); what I say is evil (R); idols (R)
decisions.reason: The wording set for these names. Readable says what "evil in my eyes" means, as in 7:30, and names the idols (m1).

decisions.choice: "con cái Y-sơ-ra-ên" (L); "dân Y-sơ-ra-ên", "dân Giu-đa" (B, R), with no gender spans
decisions.reason: As in 23:7, "con cái" and "dân" already include the whole people, men and women, so the English gender alternatives have no second Vietnamese wording through this chapter.

source.text: כִּ֧י עַל־אַפִּ֣י וְעַל־חֲמָתִ֗י הָ֤יְתָה לִּי֙ הָעִ֣יר הַזֹּ֔את לְמִן־הַיּוֹם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּנ֣וּ אוֹתָ֔הּ וְעַ֖ד הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֑ה לַהֲסִירָ֖הּ מֵעַ֥ל פָּנָֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: For on my anger and on my wrath has been to me the city this, from the day that they built it and until the day this, to remove it from before my face,

en.L: For this city has been to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} [a cause] of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} anger and of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} wrath from the day that they built it until this day, so that I [must] remove it from before {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} face,
en.B: This city has stirred up {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} anger and {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} fury from the day it was built until now, so that I must remove it from {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} sight,
en.R: From the day this city was built until now, it has made {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} angry and furious. So I will remove it from {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} sight.

es.L: Porque esta ciudad ha sido para {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} [motivo] de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} ira y de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} furor desde el día en que la edificaron hasta hoy, de modo que [he de] quitarla de delante de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} rostro,
es.B: Esta ciudad ha despertado {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} ira y {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} furor desde el día en que fue edificada hasta ahora, así que tengo que quitarla de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} vista,
es.R: Desde el día en que esta ciudad fue edificada hasta ahora, me ha hecho enojar y me ha llenado de furor. Por eso la quitaré de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} vista.

fr.L: Car cette ville a été pour {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} [un sujet] de {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} colère et de {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} fureur depuis le jour où on l’a bâtie jusqu’à ce jour, en sorte que je [dois] l’ôter de devant {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} face,
fr.B: Cette ville a excité {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} colère et {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} fureur depuis le jour où elle a été bâtie jusqu’à aujourd’hui, si bien que je dois l’ôter de devant {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} face,
fr.R: Depuis le jour où cette ville a été construite jusqu’à aujourd’hui, elle {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}a mis en colère et rendu furieux. Alors je l’ôterai de devant {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}.

sw.L: Kwa maana mji huu umekuwa {{deity_pronoun:kwangu|Kwangu}} [sababu] ya hasira {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} na ya ghadhabu {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} tangu siku walipoujenga hata siku hii ya leo, hata [imenipasa] kuuondoa mbele ya uso {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}},
sw.B: Mji huu umeamsha hasira {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} na ghadhabu {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} tangu siku ulipojengwa mpaka sasa, hata imenipasa kuuondoa mbele {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}},
sw.R: Tangu siku mji huu ulipojengwa mpaka sasa, umenikasirisha na kunighadhibisha. Kwa hiyo nitauondoa mbele {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}.

vi.L: Vì thành này đã là [cớ] khiến {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nổi giận và thịnh nộ từ ngày người ta xây nó cho đến ngày nay, đến nỗi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} [phải] dời nó khỏi trước mặt Ta,
vi.B: Thành này đã khơi dậy cơn giận và cơn thịnh nộ của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} từ ngày nó được xây cho đến nay, đến nỗi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} phải dời nó khỏi trước mặt Ta,
vi.R: Từ ngày thành này được xây cho đến nay, nó đã làm cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} giận dữ và thịnh nộ. Vì vậy {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ dời nó khỏi trước mặt Ta.

decisions.choice: has been to me on my anger and on my wrath: has been a cause of anger to me
decisions.reason: The Hebrew phrase is unusual; it says the city has been "upon" God's anger, that is, a reason for it or a weight on it. 2 Kings 24:3, 20 says the same of Judah and Jerusalem. The sense is that the city has stirred God's anger all along.

decisions.choice: from the day that they built it: from the city's beginnings
decisions.reason: Jerusalem was a Canaanite city before David took it (2 Samuel 5:6-9). The words mean that its history has been one of provoking the LORD, not a claim about who first built it.

decisions.choice: remove it from before my face: put it out of God's presence
decisions.reason: To be removed from before God's face is to be cast out of his favor and presence; 2 Kings 24:3 and 23:27 use the same words of Judah.

decisions.choice: [a cause] of (L); stirred up (B); made me angry (R); must (L, B)
decisions.reason: Each level gives the sense of the Hebrew "upon my anger" in its own way. Literal and Balanced end with a comma because the sentence runs on into verse 32; Readable ends here.

source.text: עַל֩ כָּל־רָעַ֨ת בְּנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל וּבְנֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר עָשׂוּ֙ לְהַכְעִסֵ֔נִי הֵ֤מָּה מַלְכֵיהֶם֙ שָֽׂרֵיהֶ֔ם כֹּהֲנֵיהֶ֖ם וּנְבִֽיאֵיהֶ֑ם וְאִ֣ישׁ יְהוּדָ֔ה וְיֹשְׁבֵ֖י יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: because of all [the] evil of [the] sons of Israel and [the] sons of Judah which they have done to provoke me, they, their kings, their princes, their priests and their prophets, and [the] man of Judah and [the] inhabitants of Jerusalem.

en.L: because of all the evil of the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel and the {{gender:children|sons}} of Judah that they have done to provoke {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, they, their kings, their princes, their priests and their prophets, and the {{gender:people|men}} of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
en.B: because of all the evil the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} and the {{gender:people|sons}} of Judah have done to provoke {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}: they themselves, their kings, their officials, their priests and their prophets, the people of Judah and those who live in Jerusalem.
en.R: I will do this because of all the evil things the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} and the {{gender:people|sons}} of Judah have done to make {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} angry. Their kings and leaders, their priests and prophets did it, and so did the people of Judah and of Jerusalem.

es.L: por toda la maldad de los hijos de Israel y de los hijos de Judá, que han hecho para provocarme, ellos, sus reyes, sus príncipes, sus sacerdotes y sus profetas, y {{gender:la gente de Judá|los hombres de Judá}} y los habitantes de Jerusalén.
es.B: por toda la maldad que los israelitas y la gente de Judá han hecho para provocarme: ellos mismos, sus reyes, sus jefes, sus sacerdotes y sus profetas, la gente de Judá y los que viven en Jerusalén.
es.R: Haré esto por todas las maldades que los israelitas y la gente de Judá han hecho para hacerme enojar. Lo hicieron sus reyes y sus dirigentes, sus sacerdotes y sus profetas, y también la gente de Judá y de Jerusalén.

fr.L: à cause de tout le mal que les {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël et les {{gender:enfants|fils}} de Juda ont fait pour {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}irriter, eux, leurs rois, leurs princes, leurs prêtres et leurs prophètes, et les {{gender:gens|hommes}} de Juda et les habitants de Jérusalem.
fr.B: à cause de tout le mal que les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} et les {{gender:gens|fils}} de Juda ont fait pour {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}irriter : eux-mêmes, leurs rois, leurs chefs, leurs prêtres et leurs prophètes, les gens de Juda et les habitants de Jérusalem.
fr.R: Je le ferai à cause de tout le mal que les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} et les {{gender:gens|fils}} de Juda ont fait pour {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} mettre en colère. Leurs rois et leurs chefs, leurs prêtres et leurs prophètes l’ont fait, et les gens de Juda et de Jérusalem aussi.

sw.L: kwa sababu ya uovu wote wa wana wa Israeli na wa wana wa Yuda walioufanya ili kunikasirisha, wao, wafalme wao, wakuu wao, makuhani wao na manabii wao, na watu wa Yuda na wakazi wa Yerusalemu.
sw.B: kwa sababu ya maovu yote ambayo Waisraeli na watu wa Yuda wameyafanya ili kunikasirisha: wao wenyewe, wafalme wao, maafisa wao, makuhani wao na manabii wao, watu wa Yuda na wale wanaoishi Yerusalemu.
sw.R: Nitafanya hivyo kwa sababu ya maovu yote ambayo Waisraeli na watu wa Yuda wameyafanya ili kunikasirisha. Wafalme wao na viongozi wao, makuhani wao na manabii wao waliyafanya, na vivyo hivyo watu wa Yuda na wa Yerusalemu.

vi.L: vì mọi điều ác của con cái Y-sơ-ra-ên và con cái Giu-đa đã làm để chọc giận Ta, chúng, các vua chúng, các quan trưởng chúng, các thầy tế lễ chúng và các nhà tiên tri chúng, người Giu-đa và cư dân Giê-ru-sa-lem.
vi.B: vì mọi điều ác mà dân Y-sơ-ra-ên và dân Giu-đa đã làm để chọc giận Ta: chính chúng, các vua, các quan chức, các thầy tế lễ và các nhà tiên tri của chúng, người Giu-đa và dân cư Giê-ru-sa-lem.
vi.R: Ta sẽ làm điều ấy vì mọi điều ác dân Y-sơ-ra-ên và dân Giu-đa đã làm để chọc giận Ta. Các vua và các nhà lãnh đạo, các thầy tế lễ và các nhà tiên tri của chúng đã làm điều ấy, và cả dân Giu-đa lẫn dân Giê-ru-sa-lem cũng vậy.

decisions.choice: they, their kings, their princes ...: every group of the people shares the guilt
decisions.reason: The list runs from the rulers to the whole population, as in 1:18 and 2:26. No class can say it is innocent.

decisions.choice: the man of Judah: the people of Judah as a whole
decisions.reason: The singular "man" is used for the whole body of people, men and women alike (4:4; 11:2).

decisions.choice: princes (L); officials (B); leaders (R); the people of Judah (B, R)
decisions.reason: The wording set for sar in these books. The collective "man of Judah" means everyone, so Literal gives it a gender setting and Balanced and Readable say "people". Readable starts a new sentence with "I will do this" to link it to verse 31.

source.text: וַיִּפְנ֥וּ אֵלַ֛י עֹ֖רֶף וְלֹ֣א פָנִ֑ים וְלַמֵּ֤ד אֹתָם֙ הַשְׁכֵּ֣ם וְלַמֵּ֔ד וְאֵינָ֥ם שֹׁמְעִ֖ים לָקַ֥חַת מוּסָֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: And they turned to me [the] back and not [the] face; and [though I was] teaching them, rising early and teaching, but not they [were] listening to receive correction.

en.L: And they have turned to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} the back and not the face; and though I taught them, rising early and teaching, they were not listening, to accept correction.
en.B: They have turned their backs to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, not their faces. I taught them again and again, but they did not listen or accept correction.
en.R: They have turned their backs on {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} and will not face {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}. I taught them over and over, but they would not listen. They would not learn when I corrected them.

es.L: Y {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} volvieron la espalda y no el rostro; y aunque yo les enseñaba, madrugando y enseñando, ellos no escuchaban para recibir corrección.
es.B: Me han dado la espalda, y no la cara. Les enseñé una y otra vez, pero no escucharon ni aceptaron la corrección.
es.R: Me han dado la espalda y no quieren mirarme. Les enseñé una y otra vez, pero no quisieron escuchar. No quisieron aprender cuando los corregí.

fr.L: Et ils {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}ont tourné le dos et non la face ; et alors que je les enseignais, {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} levant de bonne heure et enseignant, ils n’écoutaient pas pour recevoir la correction.
fr.B: Ils {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}ont tourné le dos, et non le visage. Je les ai instruits sans relâche, mais ils n’ont pas écouté ni accepté la correction.
fr.R: Ils {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}ont tourné le dos et refusent de {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} regarder en face. Je les ai instruits encore et encore, mais ils n’ont pas voulu écouter. Ils n’ont pas voulu apprendre quand je les corrigeais.

sw.L: Nao wamenigeuzia kisogo wala si uso; na ingawa niliwafundisha, nikiamka mapema na kuwafundisha, hawakusikiliza ili kupokea mafundisho.
sw.B: Wamenigeuzia migongo yao, si nyuso zao. Niliwafundisha tena na tena, lakini hawakusikiliza wala kukubali kuonywa.
sw.R: Wamenipa kisogo, wala hawataki kunitazama. Niliwafundisha mara nyingi sana, lakini hawakutaka kusikiliza. Hawakutaka kujifunza nilipowarekebisha.

vi.L: Chúng đã quay lưng về {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} chứ không quay mặt; dù {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã dạy chúng, dậy sớm mà dạy, chúng vẫn không nghe để nhận sự sửa dạy.
vi.B: Chúng đã quay lưng lại với {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} chứ không quay mặt về Ta. Ta đã dạy chúng hết lần này đến lần khác, nhưng chúng không chịu nghe và nhận sự sửa dạy.
vi.R: Chúng đã quay lưng lại với {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} và không chịu nhìn Ta. Ta đã nhiều lần dạy dỗ chúng, nhưng chúng không chịu nghe. Chúng không chịu học khi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sửa dạy chúng.

decisions.choice: turned to me the back and not the face: as in 2:27
decisions.reason: To show someone your back is to reject them and refuse to listen. The words are given as in 2:27 at each level.

decisions.choice: rising early and teaching: teaching again and again, without giving up
decisions.reason: To rise early to do something is to do it with urgency and keep at it. Jeremiah uses the phrase of God's persistent warnings through his prophets (7:13, 25; 11:7; 25:3-4); here the verb is "teaching".

decisions.choice: correction: discipline meant to teach
decisions.reason: As in 7:28, the word means instruction or training, often through punishment. They neither heard the teaching nor learned from the discipline.

decisions.choice: rising early and teaching (L); again and again (B); over and over (R)
decisions.reason: The wording set for this phrase throughout Jeremiah.

source.text: וַיָּשִׂ֣ימוּ שִׁקּֽוּצֵיהֶ֗ם בַּבַּ֛יִת אֲשֶׁר־נִקְרָֽא־שְׁמִ֥י עָלָ֖יו לְטַמְּאֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And they set their detestable things in the house which is called my name on it, to defile it.

en.L: And they set their detestable things in the house that is called by {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name, to defile it.
en.B: They placed their detestable idols in the house that bears {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name and so defiled it.
en.R: They put their disgusting idols in the temple that bears {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name, and so they made it unclean.

es.L: Y pusieron sus abominaciones en la casa que es llamada por {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre, para contaminarla.
es.B: Pusieron sus ídolos abominables en la casa que lleva {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre, y así la contaminaron.
es.R: Pusieron sus ídolos asquerosos en el templo que lleva {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre, y así lo hicieron impuro.

fr.L: Et ils ont placé leurs abominations dans la maison sur laquelle {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom est invoqué, pour la souiller.
fr.B: Ils ont installé leurs idoles abominables dans la maison qui porte {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom, et ils l’ont ainsi souillée.
fr.R: Ils ont mis leurs idoles dégoûtantes dans le temple qui porte {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom, et ainsi ils l’ont rendu impur.

sw.L: Nao waliweka machukizo yao katika nyumba iitwayo kwa jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}}, ili kuitia unajisi.
sw.B: Waliweka sanamu zao za kuchukiza katika nyumba iitwayo kwa jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}}, hivyo wakaitia unajisi.
sw.R: Waliweka sanamu zao za kuchukiza katika hekalu linaloitwa kwa jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}}, na hivyo wakalinajisi.

vi.L: Chúng đã đặt các vật ghê tởm của chúng trong nhà được gọi bằng danh Ta, để làm ô uế nhà ấy.
vi.B: Chúng đã đặt các thần tượng ghê tởm của chúng trong nhà mang danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} và làm ô uế nhà ấy.
vi.R: Chúng đã đặt những thần tượng ghê tởm của chúng trong đền thờ mang danh Ta, và làm cho đền thờ ra ô uế.

decisions.choice: their detestable things in the house called by my name: as 7:30
decisions.reason: The same words are used in 7:30 of idols set up in the temple; they are given here as there at each level. Manasseh had set altars and an Asherah pole in the temple (2 Kings 21:4-7), and Ezekiel saw idols there in these same years (Ezekiel 8:3-16).

decisions.choice: the house that is called by my name: the temple, which belongs to God
decisions.reason: To have someone's name called over it is to be owned by them (7:10-11; 1 Kings 8:43).

decisions.choice: idols (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in 7:30, Balanced and Readable say what the detestable things were.

source.text: וַיִּבְנוּ֩ אֶת־בָּמ֨וֹת הַבַּ֜עַל אֲשֶׁ֣ר׀בְּגֵ֣יא בֶן־הִנֹּ֗ם לְ֠הַעֲבִיר אֶת־בְּנֵיהֶ֣ם וְאֶת־בְּנוֹתֵיהֶם֮ לַמֹּלֶךְ֒ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא־צִוִּיתִ֗ים וְלֹ֤א עָֽלְתָה֙ עַל־לִבִּ֔י לַעֲשׂ֖וֹת הַתּוֹעֵבָ֣ה הַזֹּ֑את לְמַ֖עַן הַחֲטִ֥יא אֶת־יְהוּדָֽה׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And they built [the] high places of the Baal which [are] in [the] valley of Ben-hinnom, to make pass their sons and their daughters to Molech, which not I commanded them and not it came up on my heart, to do the abomination this, so as to cause to sin Judah.

en.L: And they built the high places of Baal, which [are] in the Valley of Ben-hinnom, to make their sons and their daughters pass [through the fire] to Molech, which I did not command them, and [which] did not come up into {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} heart, that they should do this abomination, to make Judah sin.
en.B: They built the high places of Baal in the Valley of Ben-hinnom, to make their sons and daughters pass through the fire for Molech, a thing I never commanded them and that never entered {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} mind, that they should do this detestable thing and so lead Judah into sin.
en.R: They built shrines for Baal in the Valley of Ben-hinnom. There they burned their sons and daughters in the fire as sacrifices to Molech. I never commanded them to do that. I never even thought of such a thing. They did this disgusting thing and led the people of Judah into sin.

es.L: Y edificaron los lugares altos de Baal, que [están] en el valle de Ben-hinom, para hacer pasar a sus hijos y a sus hijas [por el fuego] a Moloc, cosa que no les mandé, ni subió a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} corazón, que hicieran esta abominación, para hacer pecar a Judá.
es.B: Construyeron los lugares altos de Baal en el valle de Ben-hinom para hacer pasar por el fuego a sus hijos y a sus hijas en honor de Moloc, algo que yo nunca les mandé y que jamás pasó por {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} mente: que hicieran esta abominación y así llevaran a Judá al pecado.
es.R: Construyeron santuarios para Baal en el valle de Ben-hinom. Allí quemaban a sus hijos y a sus hijas en el fuego como sacrificios a Moloc. Yo nunca les mandé hacer eso. Ni siquiera se me ocurrió algo así. Hicieron esa cosa asquerosa y llevaron al pueblo de Judá a pecar.

fr.L: Et ils ont bâti les hauts lieux de Baal qui [sont] dans la vallée de Ben-Hinnom, pour faire passer leurs fils et leurs filles [par le feu] pour Molek, ce que je ne leur ai pas ordonné et [qui] ne {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}est pas monté au cœur, qu’ils commettent cette abomination, pour faire pécher Juda.
fr.B: Ils ont bâti les hauts lieux de Baal dans la vallée de Ben-Hinnom, pour faire passer leurs fils et leurs filles par le feu en l’honneur de Molek, chose que je ne leur ai jamais ordonnée et qui ne {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}est jamais venue à l’esprit, qu’ils commettent cette abomination et entraînent ainsi Juda dans le péché.
fr.R: Ils ont construit des sanctuaires pour Baal dans la vallée de Ben-Hinnom. Là, ils ont brûlé leurs fils et leurs filles dans le feu, en sacrifice à Molek. Je ne leur ai jamais ordonné de faire cela. Je n’ai même jamais pensé à une chose pareille. Ils ont fait cette chose dégoûtante et ont entraîné les gens de Juda dans le péché.

sw.L: Nao wakajenga mahali pa juu pa Baali, palipo katika Bonde la Ben-hinomu, ili kuwapitisha wana wao na binti zao [motoni] kwa Moleki, jambo ambalo sikuwaamuru, wala halikuingia moyoni {{deity_pronoun:mwangu|Mwangu}}, kwamba wafanye chukizo hili, ili kumkosesha Yuda.
sw.B: Walijenga mahali pa juu pa Baali katika Bonde la Ben-hinomu, ili kuwapitisha wana wao na binti zao motoni kwa ajili ya Moleki, jambo ambalo sikuwahi kuwaamuru wala halikuwahi kuingia akilini {{deity_pronoun:mwangu|Mwangu}}, kwamba wafanye chukizo hili na kumwongoza Yuda katika dhambi.
sw.R: Walijenga madhabahu za Baali katika Bonde la Ben-hinomu. Huko waliwachoma wana wao na binti zao motoni kama dhabihu kwa Moleki. Sikuwahi kuwaamuru kufanya hivyo. Hata sikuwahi kuwaza jambo kama hilo. Walifanya jambo hilo la kuchukiza, wakawaongoza watu wa Yuda katika dhambi.

vi.L: Chúng đã xây các nơi cao cho Ba-anh, ở trong thung lũng Bên Hi-nôm, để cho con trai con gái mình đi qua [lửa] dâng cho Mo-lóc, là điều {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} không truyền cho chúng, và [điều ấy] cũng không hề đến trong lòng Ta, rằng chúng lại làm điều ghê tởm này, để khiến Giu-đa phạm tội.
vi.B: Chúng đã xây các nơi cao cho Ba-anh trong thung lũng Bên Hi-nôm, để cho con trai con gái mình đi qua lửa dâng cho Mo-lóc, là điều {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} chưa hề truyền cho chúng và cũng chưa từng nghĩ đến, rằng chúng lại làm điều ghê tởm này mà khiến Giu-đa phạm tội.
vi.R: Chúng đã xây những nơi thờ cho thần Ba-anh trong thung lũng Bên Hi-nôm. Tại đó chúng thiêu con trai con gái mình trong lửa làm sinh tế dâng cho thần Mo-lóc. Ta chưa bao giờ truyền cho chúng làm điều đó. Ta cũng chưa bao giờ nghĩ đến một việc như thế. Chúng đã làm điều ghê tởm ấy và dẫn dân Giu-đa vào tội lỗi.

decisions.choice: which I did not command them, nor did it come into my mind: as 7:31 and 19:5
decisions.reason: The same words close 7:31, of Topheth in this valley, and 19:5, of Baal. Here they are said of the sacrifices to Molech. The wording is given as in 7:31 at each level.

decisions.choice: to make them pass to Molech: to burn children as offerings to the god Molech
decisions.reason: The verb, "to make pass over", is the one used for the rite of giving a child by fire (2 Kings 23:10; Deuteronomy 18:10); "through the fire" is understood. The law forbids giving children to Molech (Leviticus 18:21; 20:2-5). Josiah had defiled the place of burning in this valley (2 Kings 23:10), but the practice returned.

decisions.choice: the high places of Baal: raised places of worship in the valley
decisions.reason: As in 7:31 and 19:5, these are platforms or altars built in the valley, not hilltop shrines. Baal and Molech are named together; the worship of both went on in the same place.

decisions.choice: to cause to sin: the form read aloud
decisions.reason: The written Hebrew has a slightly different spelling of the verb, and the margin gives the usual form to read. The meaning is the same: they led Judah into sin.

decisions.choice: [through the fire] (L); pass through the fire (B); burned ... in the fire as sacrifices (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says only "make pass". Literal brackets "through the fire"; Balanced supplies it, as in 2 Kings 23:10; Readable says what was done, as in 7:31 and 2 Kings 23:10. Readable says "shrines" for the high places, as in 7:31.

decisions.choice: "faire passer ... [par le feu] pour Molek" (L); "par le feu en l'honneur de Molek" (B); "brûlé ... en sacrifice à Molek" (R)
decisions.reason: As 2 Kings 23:10 in French, and the wording of 19:5 for the rest of the verse.

decisions.choice: the wording of 19:5 for "which I did not command ... nor did it come into my mind"; "Mo-lóc"
decisions.reason: The same words as in 19:5 at each level, since the Hebrew repeats them; "Mo-lóc" and "Bên Hi-nôm" are the published forms of 2 Kings 23:10.

source.text: וְעַתָּ֕ה לָכֵ֛ן כֹּֽה־אָמַ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אֶל־הָעִ֨יר הַזֹּ֜את אֲשֶׁ֣ר׀אַתֶּ֣ם אֹמְרִ֗ים נִתְּנָה֙ בְּיַ֣ד מֶֽלֶךְ־בָּבֶ֔ל בַּחֶ֖רֶב וּבָרָעָ֥ב וּבַדָּֽבֶר׃

records.literal_gloss: And now therefore thus says Yahweh, [the] God of Israel, concerning the city this which you [are] saying, It has been given into [the] hand of [the] king of Babylon by the sword and by the famine and by the pestilence:

en.L: And now, therefore, thus says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of Israel, concerning this city of which you are saying, 'It has been given into the hand of the king of Babylon by the sword and by the famine and by the pestilence':
en.B: But now {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of Israel, says this about this city, of which you are saying, 'It is being handed over to the king of Babylon by sword, famine and plague':
en.R: You people are saying that this city is being handed over to the king of Babylon by war, famine and disease. But now this is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of Israel, says about it:

es.L: Y ahora, por tanto, así dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, el Dios de Israel, acerca de esta ciudad de la cual {{plural_you:ustedes dicen|vosotros decís}}: “Entregada será en mano del rey de Babilonia por la espada, por el hambre y por la peste”:
es.B: Pero ahora {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, el Dios de Israel, dice esto acerca de esta ciudad de la que {{plural_you:ustedes dicen|vosotros decís}}: “Está siendo entregada al rey de Babilonia por la espada, el hambre y la peste”:
es.R: {{plural_you:Ustedes dicen|Vosotros decís}} que esta ciudad está siendo entregada al rey de Babilonia por la guerra, el hambre y las enfermedades. Pero ahora, esto es lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, el Dios de Israel, acerca de ella:

fr.L: Et maintenant donc, ainsi parle {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, le Dieu d’Israël, au sujet de cette ville dont vous dites : “Elle est livrée entre les mains du roi de Babylone par l’épée, par la famine et par la peste” :
fr.B: Mais maintenant, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, le Dieu d’Israël, dit ceci au sujet de cette ville dont vous dites : “Elle est livrée au roi de Babylone par l’épée, la famine et la peste” :
fr.R: Vous dites que cette ville est livrée au roi de Babylone par la guerre, la famine et la maladie. Mais maintenant, voici ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, le Dieu d’Israël, au sujet de cette ville :

sw.L: Basi sasa, kwa hiyo, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa Israeli, asema hivi kuhusu mji huu ambao ninyi mnasema, 'Umetiwa mkononi mwa mfalme wa Babeli kwa upanga, na kwa njaa, na kwa tauni':
sw.B: Lakini sasa hivi ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa Israeli, asemavyo kuhusu mji huu ambao mnasema, 'Unatiwa mikononi mwa mfalme wa Babeli kwa upanga, njaa na tauni':
sw.R: Ninyi mnasema kwamba mji huu unatiwa mikononi mwa mfalme wa Babeli kwa vita, njaa na magonjwa. Lakini sasa hili ndilo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa Israeli, analosema kuuhusu:

vi.L: Vậy bây giờ, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, phán thế này về thành này, là thành mà các ngươi nói: 'Nó đã bị phó vào tay vua Ba-by-lôn bởi gươm, nạn đói và ôn dịch':
vi.B: Nhưng bây giờ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, phán như vầy về thành này, là thành mà các ngươi nói: 'Nó đang bị phó vào tay vua Ba-by-lôn bởi gươm đao, nạn đói và dịch bệnh':
vi.R: Các ngươi đang nói rằng thành này đang bị giao cho vua Ba-by-lôn vì chiến tranh, nạn đói và bệnh tật. Nhưng bây giờ, đây là lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, phán về thành ấy:

decisions.choice: and now, therefore: the turn from judgment to promise
decisions.reason: The words usually lead into a sentence of judgment, but here they open the promise of verses 37-44. Because the LORD is who he is (verse 27), the judgment now falling is not his last word.

decisions.choice: you are saying: the people, who see the city as already lost
decisions.reason: The "you" is plural. The people's despair echoes Jeremiah's own words in verses 24-25: sword, famine and pestilence have done their work. The LORD does not deny it; he speaks beyond it.

decisions.choice: And now, therefore (L); But now (B, R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "But now", since the verse turns from judgment to hope.

decisions.choice: You people are saying ... But now this is what the LORD says (R)
decisions.reason: Readable puts the people's words first and says that "you" is plural; the LORD's words then follow from verse 37. The Literal and Balanced verse ends with a colon.

source.text: הִנְנִ֤י מְקַבְּצָם֙ מִכָּל־הָ֣אֲרָצ֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֨ר הִדַּחְתִּ֥ים שָׁ֛ם בְּאַפִּ֥י וּבַחֲמָתִ֖י וּבְקֶ֣צֶף גָּד֑וֹל וַהֲשִֽׁבֹתִים֙ אֶל־הַמָּק֣וֹם הַזֶּ֔ה וְהֹשַׁבְתִּ֖ים לָבֶֽטַח׃

records.literal_gloss: Look I [am] gathering them from all the lands where I have driven them there in my anger and in my wrath and in fury great, and I will bring them back to the place this, and I will make them dwell in safety.

en.L: Look, I am gathering them from all the lands where I have driven them in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} anger and in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} wrath and in great fury, and I will bring them back to this place and make them dwell in safety.
en.B: I am going to gather them from all the lands to which I have driven them in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} anger, {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} rage and {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} great fury. I will bring them back to this place and let them live in safety.
en.R: I will gather {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people from all the countries where I drove them when I was so angry with them. I will bring them back to this place and let them live here in safety.

es.L: He aquí, yo los reúno de todas las tierras adonde los he arrojado en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} ira, y en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} furor, y en gran enojo, y los haré volver a este lugar, y los haré habitar seguros.
es.B: Voy a reunirlos de todas las tierras adonde los he arrojado en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} ira, {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} furor y {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} gran enojo. Los haré volver a este lugar y les permitiré vivir seguros.
es.R: Reuniré a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo de todos los países adonde lo arrojé cuando estaba tan enojado con ellos. Los traeré de vuelta a este lugar y dejaré que vivan aquí seguros.

fr.L: Voici, je les rassemble de tous les pays où je les ai chassés dans {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} colère, dans {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} fureur et dans une grande indignation, et je les ramènerai en ce lieu et je les y ferai habiter en sécurité.
fr.B: Je vais les rassembler de tous les pays où je les ai chassés dans {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} colère, {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} fureur et {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} grande indignation. Je les ramènerai en ce lieu et je les y ferai vivre en sécurité.
fr.R: Je rassemblerai {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple de tous les pays où je l’ai chassé quand j’étais si en colère contre lui. Je le ramènerai en ce lieu et je le laisserai y vivre en sécurité.

sw.L: Tazama, nitawakusanya kutoka nchi zote nilizowafukuzia katika hasira {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, na katika ghadhabu {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, na katika ukali mkuu; nami nitawarudisha mahali hapa na kuwakalisha salama.
sw.B: Ninakaribia kuwakusanya kutoka nchi zote nilizowafukuzia katika hasira {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, ghadhabu {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} na ukali {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} mkuu. Nitawarudisha mahali hapa na kuwaacha waishi salama.
sw.R: Nitawakusanya watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} kutoka nchi zote nilizowafukuzia nilipowakasirikia sana. Nitawarudisha mahali hapa na kuwaacha waishi hapa salama.

vi.L: Kìa, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ nhóm họ lại từ mọi xứ mà {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã xua đuổi họ đến trong cơn giận, cơn thịnh nộ và cơn phẫn nộ lớn của Ta, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đem họ trở về nơi này và cho họ ở yên ổn.
vi.B: Ta sắp nhóm họ lại từ mọi xứ mà {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã xua đuổi họ đến trong cơn giận, cơn thịnh nộ và cơn phẫn nộ lớn của Ta. Ta sẽ đem họ trở về nơi này và cho họ sống an ninh.
vi.R: Ta sẽ nhóm dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} lại từ mọi xứ mà {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã xua đuổi họ đến khi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} rất giận họ. Ta sẽ đem họ trở về nơi này và cho họ sống an toàn tại đây.

decisions.choice: I am gathering them from all the lands where I have driven them: the scattering is God's act, and so is the return
decisions.reason: The same God who drove the people out in anger will gather them in. The verse speaks as if the exile has already happened; it was still to come for most of the people. The promise of return is the heart of chapters 30-33 (23:3; 29:14; 31:8-10).

decisions.choice: anger, wrath, great fury: three words for God's anger, stressing its strength
decisions.reason: The same three words are used in 21:5 and Deuteronomy 29:27, where they describe the LORD uprooting his people from the land.

decisions.choice: dwell in safety: live securely, without fear
decisions.reason: The phrase is the Law's promise to an obedient people (Leviticus 25:18-19; Deuteronomy 12:10), and the prophets' promise for the age to come (23:6; 33:16).

decisions.choice: my people (R); when I was so angry (R)
decisions.reason: Readable names "them" as God's people and joins the three words for anger into one plain phrase.

decisions.choice: "họ" for the people God gathers
decisions.reason: In the promise of verses 37-44 God speaks of his people with the neutral "họ", as in 24:5-7, keeping "chúng" for the guilty in verses 28-35.

source.text: וְהָ֥יוּ לִ֖י לְעָ֑ם וַאֲנִ֕י אֶהְיֶ֥ה לָהֶ֖ם לֵאלֹהִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And they will be to me for a people, and I will be to them for God.

en.L: And they will be {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people, and I will be their God.
en.B: They will be {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people, and I will be their God.
en.R: They will be {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people, and I will be their God.

es.L: Y ellos serán {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo, y yo seré su Dios.
es.B: Ellos serán {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo, y yo seré su Dios.
es.R: Ellos serán {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo, y yo seré su Dios.

fr.L: Et ils seront {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple, et je serai leur Dieu.
fr.B: Ils seront {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple, et je serai leur Dieu.
fr.R: Ils seront {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple, et je serai leur Dieu.

sw.L: Nao watakuwa watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, nami nitakuwa Mungu wao.
sw.B: Watakuwa watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, nami nitakuwa Mungu wao.
sw.R: Watakuwa watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, nami nitakuwa Mungu wao.

vi.L: Họ sẽ là dân của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ là Đức Chúa Trời của họ.
vi.B: Họ sẽ là dân của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ là Đức Chúa Trời của họ.
vi.R: Họ sẽ là dân của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ là Đức Chúa Trời của họ.

decisions.choice: they will be my people, and I will be their God: the covenant promise
decisions.reason: These words sum up the covenant (Exodus 6:7; Leviticus 26:12). Jeremiah uses them in 7:23, 11:4, 24:7 and in the promises of restoration (30:22; 31:33). The wording is given as in 24:7.

source.text: וְנָתַתִּ֨י לָהֶ֜ם לֵ֤ב אֶחָד֙ וְדֶ֣רֶךְ אֶחָ֔ד לְיִרְאָ֥ה אוֹתִ֖י כָּל־הַיָּמִ֑ים לְט֣וֹב לָהֶ֔ם וְלִבְנֵיהֶ֖ם אַחֲרֵיהֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And I will give to them a heart one and a way one, to fear me all the days, for good for them and for their sons after them.

en.L: And I will give them one heart and one way, to fear {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} all the days, for good to them and to their {{gender:children|sons}} after them.
en.B: I will give them one heart and one way, so they will fear {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} for all time. It will be for their good, and for the good of their {{gender:children|sons}} who come after them.
en.R: I will make them all of one mind and give them one way to live, so that they will always fear and honor {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}. That will be good for them and for their {{gender:children|sons}} after them.

es.L: Y les daré un corazón y un camino, para que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} teman todos los días, para bien de ellos y de sus hijos después de ellos.
es.B: Les daré un solo corazón y un solo camino, para que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} teman siempre. Será para su bien, y para el bien de sus hijos que vengan después de ellos.
es.R: Haré que todos piensen de la misma manera y les daré un solo camino para vivir, para que siempre {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} teman y {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} honren. Eso será bueno para ellos y para sus hijos después de ellos.

fr.L: Et je leur donnerai un seul cœur et un seul chemin, pour {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} craindre tous les jours, pour leur bien et celui de leurs {{gender:enfants|fils}} après eux.
fr.B: Je leur donnerai un seul cœur et un seul chemin, pour qu’ils {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} craignent toujours. Ce sera pour leur bien et pour le bien de leurs {{gender:enfants|fils}} qui viendront après eux.
fr.R: Je les rendrai tous unis dans leurs pensées et je leur donnerai une seule manière de vivre, pour qu’ils {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} craignent et {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}honorent toujours. Ce sera bon pour eux et pour leurs {{gender:enfants|fils}} après eux.

sw.L: Nami nitawapa moyo mmoja na njia moja, ili wanicha {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} siku zote, kwa mema yao na ya watoto wao baada yao.
sw.B: Nitawapa moyo mmoja na njia moja, ili wanicha {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} daima. Itakuwa kwa mema yao, na kwa mema ya watoto wao watakaokuja baada yao.
sw.R: Nitawafanya wote wawe na nia moja na kuwapa njia moja ya kuishi, ili daima waniche na kuniheshimu. Hilo litakuwa jema kwao na kwa watoto wao baada yao.

vi.L: Ta sẽ ban cho họ một lòng và một đường lối, để kính sợ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} mọi ngày, vì điều tốt cho họ và cho con cái họ sau họ.
vi.B: Ta sẽ ban cho họ một lòng và một đường lối, để họ kính sợ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} mãi mãi. Điều đó sẽ đem lại phước cho họ và cho con cái họ sau này.
vi.R: Ta sẽ làm cho họ đồng lòng và ban cho họ một đường lối để sống, để họ luôn kính sợ và tôn kính Ta. Điều đó sẽ tốt cho họ và cho con cái họ sau này.

decisions.choice: one heart and one way: an undivided will and a single way of life
alternatives: another heart and another way (the ancient Greek translation)
decisions.reason: The heart is the seat of thought and will. "One heart" means a mind that is not divided between the LORD and other gods, and a people united in it; "one way" is a single way of living, in the LORD's paths. Ezekiel 11:19 promises "one heart" in the same years. The ancient Greek translation has "another way and another heart".

decisions.choice: to fear me: to hold God in awe and reverence, and so obey him
decisions.reason: Fearing the LORD means honoring him as God and living by his will (5:22, 24; Deuteronomy 6:24; 10:12).

decisions.choice: for good to them and to their children: the fear of God brings blessing to the generations
decisions.reason: The good passes on to the children, as the iniquity of the fathers did (verse 18). Deuteronomy 6:24 speaks of fearing the LORD "for our good always".

decisions.choice: one heart and one way (L, B); all of one mind ... one way to live (R); fear and honor (R)
decisions.reason: Readable says what the pictures mean, and "fear and honor" for the fear of God, as in 5:24.

source.text: וְכָרַתִּ֤י לָהֶם֙ בְּרִ֣ית עוֹלָ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹֽא־אָשׁוּב֙ מֵאַ֣חֲרֵיהֶ֔ם לְהֵיטִיבִ֖י אוֹתָ֑ם וְאֶת־יִרְאָתִי֙ אֶתֵּ֣ן בִּלְבָבָ֔ם לְבִלְתִּ֖י ס֥וּר מֵעָלָֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: And I will make with them a covenant of perpetuity, that not I will turn back from after them to do good to them; and my fear I will put in their heart, so as not to turn aside from me.

en.L: And I will make with them an everlasting covenant, that I will not turn back from [following] after them, to do them good; and I will put the fear of {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} in their heart, so that they do not turn aside from {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}.
en.B: I will make with them a covenant that is everlasting: I will not turn back from them, but will keep on doing them good. I will put the fear of {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} in their hearts so that they never turn aside from {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}.
en.R: I will make a covenant with them that will last forever. I will never stop doing good to them. I will fill their hearts with the fear of {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, so that they will never turn away from {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}.

es.L: Y haré con ellos un pacto eterno, que no me volveré atrás de [seguir] tras ellos para hacerles bien; y pondré {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} temor en su corazón, para que no se aparten de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}.
es.B: Haré con ellos un pacto que será eterno: no dejaré de seguirlos, sino que seguiré haciéndoles bien. Pondré en su corazón el temor de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} para que nunca se aparten de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}.
es.R: Haré con ellos un pacto que durará para siempre. Nunca dejaré de hacerles bien. Llenaré su corazón de temor de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}, para que nunca se aparten de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}.

fr.L: Et je conclurai avec eux une alliance éternelle, [selon laquelle] je ne {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} détournerai pas d’eux, pour leur faire du bien ; et je mettrai {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} crainte dans leur cœur, pour qu’ils ne s’écartent pas de {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}.
fr.B: Je conclurai avec eux une alliance éternelle : je ne cesserai pas de les suivre pour leur faire du bien. Je mettrai dans leur cœur la crainte de {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, pour qu’ils ne s’écartent jamais de {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}.
fr.R: Je ferai avec eux une alliance qui durera toujours. Je ne cesserai jamais de leur faire du bien. Je remplirai leur cœur de respect pour {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, pour qu’ils ne se détournent jamais de {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}.

sw.L: Nami nitafanya nao agano la milele, kwamba sitarudi nyuma kutoka kwao, ili kuwatendea mema; nami nitatia kicho {{deity_pronoun:changu|Changu}} mioyoni mwao, wasiniache.
sw.B: Nitafanya nao agano la milele: sitageuka mbali nao, bali nitaendelea kuwatendea mema. Nitatia kicho {{deity_pronoun:changu|Changu}} mioyoni mwao, ili wasigeuke kamwe kuniacha.
sw.R: Nitafanya nao agano litakalodumu milele. Sitaacha kamwe kuwatendea mema. Nitaijaza mioyo yao kicho {{deity_pronoun:changu|Changu}}, ili wasigeuke kamwe kuniacha.

vi.L: Ta sẽ lập với họ một giao ước đời đời, rằng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ không quay đi khỏi họ, mà làm điều tốt cho họ; {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đặt sự kính sợ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} trong lòng họ, để họ không lìa bỏ Ta.
vi.B: Ta sẽ lập với họ một giao ước đời đời: Ta sẽ không quay lưng với họ, nhưng sẽ luôn làm điều tốt cho họ. Ta sẽ đặt lòng kính sợ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} trong lòng họ để họ không bao giờ lìa bỏ Ta.
vi.R: Ta sẽ lập với họ một giao ước còn mãi mãi. Ta sẽ không bao giờ thôi làm điều tốt cho họ. Ta sẽ đặt lòng kính sợ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đầy dẫy trong lòng họ, để họ không bao giờ lìa bỏ Ta.

decisions.choice: an everlasting covenant: a covenant that will never be broken
decisions.reason: The covenant made at Sinai had been broken (11:10; 31:32). The new covenant of 31:31-34 is here called everlasting (also 50:5; Isaiah 55:3; Ezekiel 37:26). It lasts because God himself undertakes both sides: he will not turn away from them, and he will put in them the fear that keeps them from turning away from him.

decisions.choice: I will not turn back from after them: I will not stop following them with good
decisions.reason: "From after" pictures God following his people. He will not turn back from them, as a shepherd does not leave his flock.

decisions.choice: the fear of me in their heart: God puts it there himself
decisions.reason: The people had shown no fear of the LORD (2:19; 5:24). In the new covenant God gives the inner change himself, as with the law written on the heart (31:33) and the heart to know him (24:7).

decisions.choice: everlasting covenant (L, B); a covenant that will last forever (R)
decisions.reason: "Everlasting covenant" as in Isaiah 55:3; Readable says it in plain words.

source.text: וְשַׂשְׂתִּ֥י עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם לְהֵטִ֣יב אוֹתָ֑ם וּנְטַעְתִּ֞ים בָּאָ֤רֶץ הַזֹּאת֙ בֶּאֱמֶ֔ת בְּכָל־לִבִּ֖י וּבְכָל־נַפְשִֽׁי׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And I will rejoice over them to do good to them, and I will plant them in the land this in faithfulness, with all my heart and with all my soul.

en.L: And I will rejoice over them to do them good, and I will plant them in this land in faithfulness, with all {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} heart and with all {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} soul.
en.B: I will delight in doing them good. With all {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} heart and all {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} soul I will plant them faithfully in this land.
en.R: I will be glad to do good things for them. With all {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} heart and all {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} soul I will faithfully plant them in this land.

es.L: Y me alegraré sobre ellos haciéndoles bien, y los plantaré en esta tierra en verdad, con todo {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} corazón y con toda {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} alma.
es.B: Me deleitaré en hacerles bien. Con todo {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} corazón y con toda {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} alma los plantaré fielmente en esta tierra.
es.R: Me alegrará hacerles bien. Con todo {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} corazón y con toda {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} alma los plantaré fielmente en esta tierra.

fr.L: Et je {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} réjouirai à leur sujet pour leur faire du bien, et je les planterai dans ce pays avec fidélité, de tout {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} cœur et de toute {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} âme.
fr.B: Je prendrai plaisir à leur faire du bien. De tout {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} cœur et de toute {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} âme, je les planterai fidèlement dans ce pays.
fr.R: Je serai heureux de leur faire du bien. De tout {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} cœur et de toute {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} âme, je les planterai fidèlement dans ce pays.

sw.L: Nami nitafurahi juu yao ili kuwatendea mema, nami nitawapanda katika nchi hii kwa uaminifu, kwa moyo {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} wote na kwa nafsi {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} yote.
sw.B: Nitafurahia kuwatendea mema. Kwa moyo {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} wote na nafsi {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} yote nitawapanda kwa uaminifu katika nchi hii.
sw.R: Nitafurahi kuwatendea mambo mema. Kwa moyo {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} wote na nafsi {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} yote nitawapanda kwa uaminifu katika nchi hii.

vi.L: Ta sẽ vui mừng về họ mà làm điều tốt cho họ, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ trồng họ trong xứ này trong sự thành tín, hết lòng và hết linh hồn Ta.
vi.B: Ta sẽ vui thích làm điều tốt cho họ. Ta sẽ hết lòng, hết linh hồn trồng họ trong xứ này cách thành tín.
vi.R: Ta sẽ vui mừng làm những điều tốt lành cho họ. Ta sẽ hết lòng, hết linh hồn trồng họ trong xứ này cách thành tín.

decisions.choice: I will plant them in this land: the building and planting promised in Jeremiah's call
decisions.reason: At his call Jeremiah was sent to uproot and tear down, to build and to plant (1:10). The planting is promised again in 24:6 and 31:28; here God plants his people himself.

decisions.choice: in faithfulness: faithfully, and so for good
decisions.reason: The word means firmness, faithfulness and truth. God will plant them in a way that keeps his word, and so firmly that they will not be pulled up again (24:6).

decisions.choice: with all my heart and with all my soul: God's whole being given to his people's good
decisions.reason: Israel was told to love the LORD with all their heart and soul (Deuteronomy 6:5). Here God says that of himself: only here in the Bible does he speak of acting with all his heart and all his soul.

decisions.choice: rejoice over them: delight in them
decisions.reason: The same picture is used in Deuteronomy 30:9 and Isaiah 62:5; 65:19: God takes joy in doing good to his people.

decisions.choice: in faithfulness (L); faithfully (B, R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable turn the phrase into an adverb, which keeps the sense of m2 in natural English.

source.text: כִּֽי־כֹה֙ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר הֵבֵ֨אתִי֙ אֶל־הָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֔ה אֵ֛ת כָּל־הָרָעָ֥ה הַגְּדוֹלָ֖ה הַזֹּ֑את כֵּ֣ן אָנֹכִ֞י מֵבִ֤יא עֲלֵיהֶם֙ אֶת־כָּל־הַטּוֹבָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָנֹכִ֖י דֹּבֵ֥ר עֲלֵיהֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: For thus says Yahweh: Just as I have brought to the people this all the disaster the great this, so I [am] bringing on them all the good which I [am] speaking concerning them.

en.L: For thus says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}: Just as I have brought on this people all this great disaster, so I am bringing on them all the good that I am speaking concerning them.
en.B: For {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says this: As I have brought on this people all this great disaster, so I will bring on them all the good I promise them.
en.R: This is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says: I have brought all this terrible trouble on these people. In the same way, I will bring them all the good things I have promised them.

es.L: Porque así dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: Así como he traído sobre este pueblo todo este gran mal, así traigo sobre ellos todo el bien que hablo acerca de ellos.
es.B: Porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dice esto: Así como he traído sobre este pueblo toda esta gran desgracia, así traeré sobre ellos todo el bien que les prometo.
es.R: Esto es lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: He traído sobre este pueblo toda esta terrible desgracia. De la misma manera, les traeré todas las cosas buenas que les he prometido.

fr.L: Car ainsi parle {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : De même que j’ai fait venir sur ce peuple tout ce grand malheur, ainsi je fais venir sur eux tout le bien que je leur annonce.
fr.B: Car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit ceci : Comme j’ai fait venir sur ce peuple tout ce grand malheur, ainsi je ferai venir sur eux tout le bien que je leur promets.
fr.R: Voici ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : J’ai fait venir tout ce terrible malheur sur ce peuple. De la même manière, je leur donnerai tout le bien que je leur ai promis.

sw.L: Kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asema hivi: Kama nilivyoleta juu ya watu hawa maafa haya yote makuu, ndivyo nitakavyoleta juu yao mema yote ninayoyanena juu yao.
sw.B: Kwa maana hivi ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asemavyo: Kama nilivyoleta juu ya watu hawa maafa haya yote makuu, ndivyo nitakavyowaletea mema yote ninayowaahidi.
sw.R: Hili ndilo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} analosema: Nimeleta taabu hii yote kubwa juu ya watu hawa. Vivyo hivyo nitawaletea mambo yote mema niliyowaahidi.

vi.L: Vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán thế này: Như {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã giáng trên dân này mọi tai họa lớn này thể nào, thì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} cũng sẽ giáng trên họ mọi điều tốt lành mà {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã phán về họ thể ấy.
vi.B: Vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán như vầy: Như {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã giáng trên dân này mọi tai họa lớn này, thì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} cũng sẽ ban cho họ mọi điều tốt lành {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã hứa với họ.
vi.R: Đây là lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán: Ta đã giáng trên dân này mọi tai họa khủng khiếp này. Cũng vậy, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ ban cho họ mọi điều tốt lành {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã hứa với họ.

decisions.choice: just as ... so: the disaster is as sure as the good, and the good as sure as the disaster
decisions.reason: The judgment Jeremiah had announced for years had come true (verse 24). That proves that the good he now announces will come true too (31:28).

decisions.choice: the good that I am speaking concerning them: the good God promises
decisions.reason: To speak good concerning someone is to promise it (33:14). "Disaster" and "good" are the same pair as in 21:10: harm that comes on a people and blessing that comes to them.

decisions.choice: speaking concerning them (L); promise them (B); have promised (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what the speaking is.

source.text: וְנִקְנָ֥ה הַשָּׂדֶ֖ה בָּאָ֣רֶץ הַזֹּ֑את אֲשֶׁ֣ר׀אַתֶּ֣ם אֹמְרִ֗ים שְׁמָמָ֥ה הִיא֙ מֵאֵ֤ין אָדָם֙ וּבְהֵמָ֔ה נִתְּנָ֖ה בְּיַ֥ד הַכַּשְׂדִּֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And will be bought the field in the land this, which you [are] saying, A desolation it [is], without human and beast; it has been given into [the] hand of the Chaldeans.

en.L: And the field will be bought in this land of which you are saying, 'It [is] a desolation, without human or beast; it has been given into the hand of the Chaldeans.'
en.B: Fields will be bought in this land of which you are saying, 'It is a desolate waste, with no people or animals; it has been handed over to the Chaldeans.'
en.R: You are saying, 'This land is empty and ruined. There are no people or animals in it. It has been handed over to the Babylonians.' But people will buy fields in this land again.

es.L: Y se comprará el campo en esta tierra de la cual {{plural_you:ustedes dicen|vosotros decís}}: “Desolada [está], sin hombre ni animal; entregada ha sido en mano de los caldeos”.
es.B: Se comprarán campos en esta tierra de la que {{plural_you:ustedes dicen|vosotros decís}}: “Es una desolación, sin gente ni animales; ha sido entregada a los caldeos”.
es.R: {{plural_you:Ustedes dicen|Vosotros decís}}: “Esta tierra está vacía y arruinada. No hay gente ni animales en ella. Ha sido entregada a los babilonios”. Pero la gente volverá a comprar campos en esta tierra.

fr.L: Et l’on achètera le champ dans ce pays dont vous dites : “C’[est] une désolation, sans humains ni bêtes ; il est livré entre les mains des Chaldéens.”
fr.B: On achètera des champs dans ce pays dont vous dites : “C’est un désert dévasté, sans gens ni bêtes ; il est livré aux Chaldéens.”
fr.R: Vous dites : “Ce pays est vide et en ruines. Il n’y a ni gens ni animaux. Il est livré aux Babyloniens.” Mais les gens achèteront de nouveau des champs dans ce pays.

sw.L: Na shamba litanunuliwa katika nchi hii ambayo mnasema, 'Ni ukiwa, bila mwanadamu wala mnyama; imetiwa mkononi mwa Wakaldayo.'
sw.B: Mashamba yatanunuliwa katika nchi hii ambayo mnasema, 'Ni nyika tupu, bila watu wala wanyama; imetiwa mikononi mwa Wakaldayo.'
sw.R: Mnasema, 'Nchi hii ni tupu na imeharibiwa. Hakuna watu wala wanyama ndani yake. Imetiwa mikononi mwa Wababeli.' Lakini watu watanunua tena mashamba katika nchi hii.

vi.L: Người ta sẽ mua đồng ruộng trong xứ này, là xứ mà các ngươi nói: 'Ấy [là] nơi hoang vu, không có người cũng không có thú vật; nó đã bị phó vào tay người Canh-đê.'
vi.B: Người ta sẽ mua đồng ruộng trong xứ này, là xứ mà các ngươi nói: 'Nó là nơi hoang vu, không người, không thú vật; nó đã bị phó vào tay người Canh-đê.'
vi.R: Các ngươi đang nói: 'Xứ này hoang vắng và đổ nát. Không còn người hay thú vật trong đó. Nó đã bị giao cho quân Ba-by-lôn.' Nhưng người ta sẽ lại mua đồng ruộng trong xứ này.

decisions.choice: the field will be bought: the promise of verse 15 repeated
decisions.reason: The singular "the field" means fields in general. The promise picks up Jeremiah's purchase (verses 9-15): what he did in the face of ruin, many will do again.

decisions.choice: a desolation, without human or beast: an empty, ruined land
decisions.reason: The words describe a land laid waste and left empty, as the prophets warned (4:7; 9:10; 33:10, 12). The people say it as if it were already true.

decisions.choice: the field (L); fields (B, R)
decisions.reason: The singular is collective; Balanced and Readable use the plural.

decisions.choice: But people will buy fields in this land again (R)
